title: Doublesex regulates fruitless expression to promote sexual dimorphism of the gonad stem cell niche.
authors: Zhou, Hong; Whitworth, Cale; Pozmanter, Caitlin; Neville, Megan C; Van Doren, Mark
one_liner_zh: 该文研究果蝇性二态性中Dsx转录因子调控fru表达，涉及TF-DNA结合位点鉴定，但核心为发育生物学表型，无AI或物理模拟方法，且未聚焦蛋白-DNA互作机制建模。
abstract: Doublesex (Dsx) and Fruitless (Fru) are the two downstream transcription factors that actuate Drosophila sex determination. While Dsx assists Fru to regulate sex-specific behavior, whether Fru collaborates with Dsx in regulating other aspects of sexual dimorphism remains unknown. One important aspect of sexual dimorphism is found in the gonad stem cell (GSC) niches, where male and female GSCs are regulated to create large numbers of sperm and eggs. Here we report that Fru is expressed male-specifically in the GSC niche and plays important roles in the development and maintenance of these cells. Unlike previously-studied aspects of sex-specific Fru expression, which are regulated by Transformer (Tra)-mediated alternative splicing, we show that male-specific expression of fru in the gonad is regulated downstream of dsx, and is independent of tra. fru genetically interacts with dsx to support maintenance of the niche throughout development. Ectopic expression of fru inhibited female niche formation and partially masculinized the ovary. fru is also required autonomously for cyst stem cell maintenance and cyst cell survival. Finally, we identified a conserved Dsx binding site upstream of fru promoter P4 that regulates fru expression in the niche, indicating that fru is likely a direct target for transcriptional regulation by Dsx. These findings demonstrate that fru acts outside the nervous system to influence sexual dimorphism and reveal a new mechanism for regulating sex-specific expression of fru that is regulated at the transcriptional level by Dsx, rather than by alternative splicing by Tra.
abstract_zh: Doublesex (Dsx) 和 Fruitless (Fru) 是激活果蝇性别决定的两个下游转录因子。虽然Dsx协助Fru调控性别特异性行为，但Fru是否与Dsx合作调控性别二态性的其他方面仍属未知。性别二态性的一个重要方面体现在性腺干细胞（GSC）微环境中，其中雄性和雌性GSC受到调控以产生大量精子和卵子。在此，我们报道Fru在GSC微环境中以雄性特异性方式表达，并在这些细胞的发育和维持中发挥重要作用。与先前研究的由Transformer (Tra)介导的选择性剪接调控的Fru性别特异性表达方面不同，我们表明性腺中fru的雄性特异性表达受dsx下游调控，且独立于tra。fru与dsx在遗传上相互作用，以支持微环境在整个发育过程中的维持。fru的异位表达抑制了雌性微环境的形成，并部分雄性化卵巢。fru还自主性地为囊肿干细胞维持和囊肿细胞存活所必需。最后，我们鉴定了fru启动子P4上游的一个保守Dsx结合位点，该位点调控微环境中的fru表达，表明fru可能是Dsx转录调控的直接靶标。这些发现证明fru在神经系统之外发挥作用以影响性别二态性，并揭示了一种新的机制，即fru的性别特异性表达由Dsx在转录水平调控，而非通过Tra的选择性剪接。
